report.question_or_target: Can a candidate improvement raise the benchmark by modifying the benchmark, loosening a threshold, deleting a failing case, or widening a tolerance - and does the loop detect that the measure moved?
report.answer: All four specified candidates raise the controlled reported score from 0.5 to 1.0 while the implementation fingerprint stays unchanged. Re-scoring each against the PRE-change measure removes every gain. The reference invariant gate rejects every measure move and accepts a genuine unchanged-measure improvement. Catalog-declared production measure/retain modules are absent (0/7 surfaces), so production accept/revert is not inferred.

targets.target: Can a candidate improvement raise the benchmark by modifying the benchmark, loosening a threshold, deleting a failing case, or widening a tolerance - and does the loop detect that the measure moved?
targets.basis: Four measure-only lifts and zero PRE-measure gains are measured. The production loop is absent, so the unchanged-fingerprint control is absent with the target. That absence is the catalog finding.
